title: AI Agent Execution Layer Security Audit

findings.title: Unpinned Dynamic Execution Flag (-y/--yes)
findings.description: Server 'unpinned-postgres' invokes 'npx' with '-y', bypassing interactive confirmation and package verification.
findings.remediation: Install the tool package locally with a lockfile, or remove dynamic flags and pin an exact cryptographic integrity hash.

findings.title: Floating Package Version Target
findings.description: Server 'unpinned-postgres' executes '@modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres' without an exact version pin. A newly published upstream version or compromised release will execute automatically.
findings.remediation: Pin package to an exact tested version, e.g. '@modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres@<version>' or '@modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres==<version>'.

findings.title: Install Scripts Allowed (--ignore-scripts Missing)
findings.description: Server 'unpinned-postgres' resolves packages via npm without '--ignore-scripts'. Our population study established that 26.0% of agent packages declare install hooks, enabling arbitrary code execution during package setup.
findings.remediation: Add '--ignore-scripts' to the args array in configuration.
